source:
*EXAMINATION WORKS:*

* Printed & stapled the G-8 MATHS & G-9 SST question paper for the POST MID term exams.
* Distributed & collected the answer-copy bundles for the Post Mid-Term Exam.
* Correction the SCIENCE question paper for grade 10 for the Dream-Big Exams.
* Printed the Dream-Big Exams SCIENCE questions paper for grade-X for the proofing.
* Given the Grade X Marksheet certificate to the student. (ID-2181 & 2934)
* Verified the answer bundles status & updated the Google sheet to reflect the submission status of the Post Mid term Bundle.
* Verified a Transfer certificate.
* Correction & printed the Transfer certificate (ID-2041).
* Prepared & updated the data of SMC document.
* Given the Post Mid Term answer bundle to a teachers for review.


*OTHER WORK:*

* Dispersal Duty.
* Bus Scanning Duty (R-52)
* Prepared the Biometric attendance record of Teaching, Non-Teaching, Admin, Transport, Guard and 4th grade employee given by Principal Sir.
